description: Details pursuant to Condition 7(partial) of the listed building consent dated 11 June 2025 (RN:25/01205/LBC), namely details of the new external fire escape stairs (part 4), the new pavement lights and supporting structure in the Weymouth Street lightwell (part 5), the new or adjusted balustrades and railings (part 6), the new guardrail and glass balustrade in the Library (Part 7), the new bronze grilles in the Florence Hall floor (part 12), and the alterations to the stage in the Jarvis Hall (part 13); and details pursuant to Condition 8 of the listed building consent dated 11 June 2025 (RN:25/01205/LBC), namely a plan to show the building's areas of high significance and details of the position, type, and method of installation of services and related fixtures, including any fire safety works, in areas designated as "high significance", with particular regard to the Jarvis and Florence Hall, Main Foyer and Central Staircase.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
